TextContext.SourceString: （呼……最近的工作真多啊。伸懒腰时几乎能听见关节被拉伸的“咔哒”声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Phew… so much work lately. I can almost hear my bones cracking with this stretch.)

TextContext.SourceString: （好在今天的文件都处理得差不多了……呃，这份被单独放在一边的文档是……？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Hmm, looks like most of today’s files are done… What’s this one set aside for?)

TextContext.SourceString: （一份紧急加密文档。收件人是伊薇特。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (An urgent, encrypted document addressed to Yvette.)

TextContext.SourceString: （日期……是今天啊。这个点还没送到，对方也不催促的吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It’s dated for today… Why hasn’t she asked for it yet?)

TextContext.SourceString: （不过想想收件人是伊薇特，倒也合理。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Then again, it’s Yvette… that explains it, I guess.)

TextContext.SourceString: （正好今天能早点结束工作，我去跑一趟就当锻炼身体了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Good thing I'm done early today. I’ll drop this off—consider it exercise.)

TextParam.SourceString: 留下一张说明情况的便利贴后，拿着文件离开了星庇所。
TextParam.LocalizedString: (Leaving a note to explain the situation, the Navigator grabs the document and departs from Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （是这个地址没错，之前伊薇特给过我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yep, this is the address Yvette gave me before.)

TextContext.SourceString: 叮叮叮，您有文件送达，请查收！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, you’ve got a delivery!

TextContext.SourceString: （门打开了，一个巨大、健壮、多毛的身影出现在我的面前，甚至超出了门框可见的范围。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The door swings open, revealing a tall, robust, furry figure.)

TextContext.SourceString: 菲？怎么是你——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay? Why are you?

TextContext.SourceString: （这个画面已经够惊悚了，直到下一秒，菲张嘴，发出了伊薇特的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Suddenly, Fay begins speaking in Yvette’s voice, escalating the already bizarre situation.)

TextContext.SourceString: 您好，伊薇特现在不在，快递和外卖交给我就好。那个，我是菲……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hello, Yvette isn’t here right now. You can leave deliveries and takeout with me. Oh, I’m Fay, by the way…

TextContext.SourceString: 菲把伊薇特吃掉了？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did you eat Yvette?!

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特变成菲了？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did Yvette turn into Fay?!

TextContext.SourceString: 好熟悉的声音……那个，是引航者吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That voice… Is that you, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: （不远处响起急促的脚步声，几秒之后，伊薇特出现在我面前，小小地喘着气。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The sound of hurried footsteps echoes nearby. Yvette appears, slightly out of breath.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你好呀，伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 我还以为听错了……还好，没有让引航者等太久……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I thought I was imagining things… Thank goodness you didn’t have to wait too long!

TextContext.SourceString: 因为接待陌生人会有点压力……所以快递和文件之类的，都是菲帮我代收。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Meeting new people can be stressful, so Fay usually handles deliveries for me.

TextContext.SourceString: 希望刚刚没有吓到你……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I hope he didn’t scare you…

TextContext.SourceString: 吓到了，以为你被菲夺舍了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: He did! I thought he took over your body.

TextContext.SourceString: 这有啥，我和菲也是老熟人了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No worries, Fay and I go way back.

TextContext.SourceString: 总之，不好意思，让引航者看笑话了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry, that must've seemed pretty silly...

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……！一直让你站在门口太失礼了，快请进……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh…! How rude of me to make you stand at the door this whole time. Please, come in…

TextParam.SourceString: 在客厅的沙发上坐下来后，两杯水也随之端了上来。
TextParam.LocalizedString: After settling on the living room sofa, two glasses of water are brought out.

TextContext.SourceString: 一杯加冰的，一杯不加冰的……想喝哪一杯都行。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After settling on the living room sofa, two glasses of water are brought out.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……今天引航者来找我，是有什么事情吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: One’s on the rocks, the other’s plain… Choose whichever you like.

TextContext.SourceString: 没事就不可以来找伊薇特吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, what brings you by today, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 当、当然不是……只是，之前引航者从没有来拜访过……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course, you can… It's just, you've never visited before.

TextContext.SourceString: 不开玩笑了，我是来送这份文件的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m here to deliver this document.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶……！我还以为它被忘记了，准备等会儿自己去跑一趟。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really?! I thought it got lost. I was about to head out to check myself.

TextContext.SourceString: 没有被忘记真是太好了。这样，研究就可以被按时推进了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So glad it didn’t disappear; now I can keep my research on schedule.

TextContext.SourceString: 我看到它被标注了“加急”，和其他文件分开放。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I noticed it marked as "urgent" and separated from the others.

TextContext.SourceString: 但，确实是被忘记了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, it was kind of forgotten.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，这样吗……那麻烦引航者了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, I see… Thank you for bringing it.

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特眼中的失落一闪而过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A fleeting hint of disappointment passes through Yvette’s eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 下次再遇到这种情况……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Next time you should…

TextContext.SourceString: 直接打电话来催促吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just give me a call to remind us!

TextContext.SourceString: 这、这不好吧……星庇所的大家都很忙……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But… I don’t want to bother anyone. Everyone’s busy at Astral Sanctuary...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果一直不发出声音。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you never speak up.

TextContext.SourceString: 就更会被遗忘的哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It might get forgotten for real.
Sigh...

TextContext.SourceString: 至少，对我可以有话直说。
TextContext.LocalizedString: At least, make sure to speak up with me.

TextContext.SourceString: ……好。我会记着引航者的话。下次，努力发出自己的声音……
TextContext.LocalizedString: …Okay. I’ll remember, Navigator. Next time, I’ll try to make myself heard.

TextContext.SourceString: 这样的话，至少引航者不会忘记我吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, at least you wouldn’t forget about me, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 当然。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Never.

TextContext.SourceString: （和伊薇特立下了约定……希望她会遵守。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A promise was made with Yvette… Fingers crossed she sticks to it.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那，就这么说定了哦？今天下班的时候，要多注意四周的情况。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, we have a deal, right? After work, keep an eye on your surroundings.

TextContext.SourceString: 街道边的角落……树的背后……墙的拐角处……之类的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Like the corners of the street... behind trees... around walls...

TextContext.SourceString: 好，我会注意的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got it, I’ll be on the lookout.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，那待会儿见！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, see you later!

TextContext.SourceString: （强忍着笑意挂断了伊薇特打来的电话。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I stifled a laugh as I hung up Yvette's call.)

TextContext.SourceString: （对方似乎还没有发现自己暴露了“意图”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She doesn’t seem to realize her “intentions” have been exposed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不过，能主动打来电话，已经是一件值得鼓励的事情了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Still, the fact that she made the call herself is a commendable step forward.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在回家的路上，特意放慢了脚步，同时仔细观察着四周。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (On my way home, I deliberately slowed my pace, carefully observing my surroundings.)

TextContext.SourceString: （果不其然，在便利店的屋檐下发现了一只兜帽小熊正在探头探脑。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (And, just as I suspected, there it was—a little hooded teddy bear peeking out from under the convenience store’s awning.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这么巧，在这里遇到啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fancy meeting you here!

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀，伊薇特也没想到，会在这里遇到引航者……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, I didn't expect to see you here, Navigator…

TextContext.SourceString: 那既然这么有缘分，要……要顺便参与一下“超弦体数据可视化设备”的测试吗……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since we’ve run into each other, would you like to… help test the "Superstring Data Visualization Device"...?

TextContext.SourceString: 陌生的名词出现了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The what?

TextContext.SourceString: 真实的目的暴露了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: So that's what you're up to.

TextContext.SourceString: 呜……因为除了引航者，实在不知道该找谁了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ugh…I didn’t know who else to ask except for you...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特从口袋里，掏出一个有着圆形屏幕的徽章形设备。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette pulls out a badge-shaped device with a round screen from her pocket.)

TextContext.SourceString: 只需要佩戴在手腕上，就能将收集到的超弦体数据转化为可视化信息……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just wear it on your wrist, and it’ll convert all Superstring data into visual info...

TextContext.SourceString: 无论是身体机能这种具体指标，还是情绪、感情这种抽象指标，都没问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whether it’s concrete metrics like physical conditions, or abstract ones like emotions, it’s all covered.

TextContext.SourceString: 最初的研发目标是为了监测战士们的生理数据，好提供及时的帮助。但伊薇特觉得……心理健康也很重要吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was initially designed to monitor agents' vitals for timely assistance. But I believe... mental health matters too, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 最后就变成了类似读心装置的东西……不过，还是很实用的！这可倾注了伊薇特不少的心血！
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, it turned into something like a mind-reading gadget… but it’s practical! I’ve poured a lot of heart into it!

TextContext.SourceString: 对超弦体的数据分析需要大量包括普通人在内的实验样本，否则数据支撑不够。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Analyzing Superstring data needs a vast number of test samples, including regular people, for solid data support.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果因为没有实验对象而搁置了进度……伊薇特会很难过的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If we lag in progress due to a lack of subjects... I'd be quite upset...

TextContext.SourceString: （糟糕啊，伊薇特露出了委屈的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Uh-oh, Yvette’s showing a pouty expression.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我当然会帮助伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course, I'll help you.

TextContext.SourceString: 但我认为有更好的实验对象。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I think there are better test subjects.

TextContext.SourceString: 真、真的吗！他们……会愿意帮我测试吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Re-really?! Do you think they'll agree to help?

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么不亲自问问？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why not ask them yourself?

TextContext.SourceString: 你的意思是……啊！引航者，要去哪里——
TextContext.LocalizedString: You mean... Hey! Navigator, where are we going—?

TextParam.SourceString: 趁伊薇特不注意，拉着她的手往反方向狂奔而去。
TextParam.LocalizedString: (While Yvette is momentarily distracted, I pull her by the hand and sprint in the opposite direction.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呼……呼……怎么回到欧泊了……引航者……是要找谁吗……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huff… How’d we end up back at P.U.S? Navigator… are we looking for someone?

TextContext.SourceString: （暂时先忽视了伊薇特的提问，而是在四周寻找着。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Ignoring Yvette’s question for now, I scan the area.)

TextContext.SourceString: （终于，眼前出现了一个熟悉的背影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Finally, I spot a familiar silhouette ahead.)

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kokona!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，谁叫我？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh, who was calling me?

TextContext.SourceString: （在心夏回头之前把伊薇特推到了她背后。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before Kokona can turn around, I nudge Yvette forward.)

TextContext.SourceString: 是伊薇特啊，还有引航者，有什么事吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, it’s Yvette, and the Navigator too. Is something up?

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏前辈……不、不好意思打扰……那个……我……你……请帮忙……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kokona... S-sorry to bother you... um... I... could you... please help..

TextContext.SourceString: （干脆直接抬起伊薇特拿着设备的手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Gently lifting Yvette's hand with the device.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这是你新发明的装置吗？圆圆的很可爱嘛。干什么用的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this a new gadget of yours? It looks cute and round. What's it do?

TextContext.SourceString: （感觉到伊薇特的手臂有一瞬间僵直。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette’s arm tenses for a moment.)

TextContext.SourceString: 它、它的名字……“超弦体数据可视化设备”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It-it’s called the "Superstring Data Visualization Device"...

TextContext.SourceString: （起初，伊薇特的声音有些颤抖。但最后，她设法平静了下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Initially, Yvette’s voice wavers, but she gradually regains her calm.)

TextContext.SourceString: 如果，心夏前辈有空的话，我可以给你详细介绍一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you have time, I’d love to give you a detailed rundown.

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特给心夏认真介绍了设备的功能，并进行了提问。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette thoroughly explains the device's functions to Kokona, asking questions in between.)

TextContext.SourceString: （随后，她在随身携带的平板上记录下了心夏的反馈结果。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She then records Kokona's feedback on her tablet.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这样大概就够了……心夏前辈，谢谢你！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That’s about it… Kokona, thank you so much!

TextContext.SourceString: 小事，那我先撤啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No problem at all, see you guys around!

TextContext.SourceString: （目送心夏离开的伊薇特一直没有回头，情不自禁有些担心起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Kokona leaves, Yvette watches until she’s out of sight, worry creeping in.)

TextContext.SourceString: （戳戳伊薇特的肩膀）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Tap Yvette’s shoulder)

TextContext.SourceString: 生气了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you upset?

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 你实在是太厉害了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You’re incredible!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh?

TextContext.SourceString: 可是我什么都没做啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I didn’t do anything...

TextContext.SourceString: 居然能让我这样的人，都迈出了寻找实验对象的第一步，引航者真是太厉害了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You managed to make even someone like me take the first step to find test subjects... You’re amazing...

TextContext.SourceString: 只是做了一点微小的贡献。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just doing my part.

TextContext.SourceString: 只是把你的手抬了起来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All I did was raise your arm, like literally...

TextContext.SourceString: 不不不……虽然是个很小的动作，但对我意义却很重大呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, no… Even something small like that means so much to me!

TextContext.SourceString: 想着临阵脱逃的话，会让引航者很为难……只好硬着头皮开口了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thinking about running away would just make things hard for you, so I had to muster the courage to speak up...

TextContext.SourceString: 好在进行得很顺利，也拿到了第一份测试数据。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Everything went smoothly, and we got our first bit of test data.

TextContext.SourceString: 好开心……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m so happy…!

TextContext.SourceString: （能看到伊薇特这样满足的表情， 是个意外的惊喜。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing Yvette so content is a delightful surprise.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不过，“像我这样的人”什么的……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But, "someone like me"...)

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特刚刚说“你这样的人”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You mentioned "someone like you"…

TextContext.SourceString: 是想说什么样的人呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do you mean by that?
Uh...eh...

TextContext.SourceString: 那个，像我这样，胆子小又笨嘴笨舌，一上来就给别人添麻烦的人……就算不想搭理我也很正常……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, someone timid, awkward with words, and always causing trouble for others... it's perfectly normal if people would rather not deal with me…

TextContext.SourceString: 在我看来，说出这种话的伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hearing you say those things, Yvette...

TextContext.SourceString: 有点小小的傲慢呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sounds a bit like pride, doesn’t it?

TextContext.SourceString: 傲慢？怎么会……光是不让自己变得更自卑，都很辛苦了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pride? How so… It's hard enough just trying not to feel more insecure...

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎被我的话吓了一跳，伊薇特往后退了一步，露出了不被理解的难过表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My earlier words shocked her, and Yvette stepped back, looking misunderstood and upset.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然于心不忍，但作为伊薇特唯一可以求助的人，我不得不帮助她。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Though it tears at me, as the only one Yvette can rely on, I can’t help but support her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 在没有尝试过接触的前提下，
TextContext.LocalizedString: Without attempting contact, assuming...

TextContext.SourceString: 先进行“一定会被拒绝”的预设……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That you’ll certainly be turned down…

TextContext.SourceString: 这也是一种“傲慢”哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That’s also a form of "pride," you know.

TextContext.SourceString: 我好像……稍微理解了引航者的意思……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I think… I might understand what you mean, Navigator…

TextContext.SourceString: 这么看来，伊薇特的“傲慢”确有其事呢。之前没有意识到……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Seems like being proud applies to me, too. I hadn't realized before...

TextContext.SourceString: 擅自揣测别人的想法行为……确实有些“傲慢”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Assuming others’ thoughts and actions without basis... is indeed a form of "pride."

TextContext.SourceString: （稍加思索后，伊薇特握紧拳头，露出认真的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Deep in thought, Yvette clenches her fist, with a determined look.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，可以拜托引航者，再陪伊薇特一会吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... could I ask for your company a bit longer, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 实验数据，理应要越多越好！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The more experimental data, the better!

TextContext.SourceString: （和伊薇特一起来到了繁华的商业广场。虽然人并没有节假日那么多，但对伊薇特来说，依然是个不小的挑战。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Together with Yvette, they move through the bustling plaza. Though not as crowded as a holiday, it's still quite a challenge for Yvette.)

TextContext.SourceString: （光是试图阻止伊薇特隐身的动作就进行了三次……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just stopping Yvette from slipping away was an effort…)

TextContext.SourceString: （在由我牵头，找寻了四五组测试对象后，伊薇特决定主动出击来结束本轮测试。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After finding four or five groups of test subjects, Yvette decides to take initiative for the final test.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呼气……吸气……呼……哈……我做好准备了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Okay... Deep breaths... I’m ready...

TextContext.SourceString: ……从小孩子开始，一定没问题……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Starting with kids... there shouldn't be any issue...

TextContext.SourceString: （在我鼓励眼神的注视下，伊薇特迈着僵硬的步伐走向了一对母子。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With my encouraging gaze, Yvette walked stiffly toward a mother and her child.)

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特简单说明了来意后，年轻母亲的脸上露出了好奇的神情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After Yvette briefly explained her purpose, the young mother's face lit up with curiosity.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我刚带着这孩子去报补习班来着，感觉他不是很情愿，但最后也答应了。要不，你试试看？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I just took him to sign up for classes. He didn't seem into it, but eventually, he agreed. Maybe you could try?

TextContext.SourceString: （小男孩系上表带没两分钟，圆形徽章上就印出一个蓝色的哭脸。我和伊薇特惊讶地对视一眼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just moments after the boy puts on the device, a blue frowny face appears on the screen. Yvette and I share a surprised glance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 愤怒值24，恐惧值46，悲伤值……97？啊？这数据准吗？你跟妈妈说实话，你真这样觉得吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anger level 24, fear level 46, sadness level 97?! What? Are these readings accurate? Tell me, do you really feel that way?

TextContext.SourceString: 我……呜呜……哇——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I... sniffle... Wahh—

TextContext.SourceString: 就是这样啊！人家真的不想上补习班嘛！可是，要是不上，妈妈会生气……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I really don’t wanna go to tutoring! But if I don’t, you'll be mad...

TextContext.SourceString: 嗨呀，你这孩子，从小就这么别扭。你要是真的不想，就跟妈妈说啊，你不说我怎么知道呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh dear, you're so stubborn... If you don’t wanna go, you need to say so, how am I supposed to know otherwise?

TextContext.SourceString: 算了算了，还是爱玩的年纪。这补习班不上也罢。下次可得跟妈妈说实话啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Okay, okay, still too young for extra classes. Skipping it is fine. Next time, just tell Mom, huh?

TextContext.SourceString: （年轻妈妈哭笑不得地抱着还在哇哇大哭的小男孩离开了，临走时，不住向伊薇特道谢。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the mother laughingly hugs her crying son, they depart, repeatedly thanking Yvette before leaving.)

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么样，并不可怕吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: See, not so scary, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 小伊薇特立大功！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Way to go, Yvette!

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯……感觉还顺便做了件善事……不上补习班的话，就会有更多机会，享受快乐的童年时光了吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah… Feels like we even did something nice… Now he can enjoy fun times as a kid...

TextContext.SourceString: （望着母子远去的方向若有所思，随后又认真地看向伊薇特。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Gazing thoughtfully at the retreating duo, Yvette turns her serious focus back to me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特和那个小孩有点像呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You’re a bit like that kid, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 不直接表达真实想法的话，会让在意你的人很难办啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you don’t voice your true thoughts, it’s hard for those who care about you.

TextContext.SourceString: （下定决心，不容拒绝地把设备绑定在伊薇特的手腕上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With determination, I attach the device to Yvette's wrist.)

TextContext.SourceString: （手指不小心触碰到了伊薇特的掌心，有点凉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My fingers accidentally brush Yvette’s palm; it’s a bit cool to the touch.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引、引航者！
TextContext.LocalizedString: N- Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: （徽章屏幕上显示出一张涨得通红的小圆脸。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The screen reveals a flushed, red face emoji.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特本人……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I imagine Yvette…

TextContext.SourceString: 应该最知道测试数据的准确性吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Would know the data’s accuracy best.

TextContext.SourceString: 不不不、不行吧……这实在……想什么全被知道的话……呜……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, no… It's not okay for… thoughts to be uncovered...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特头顶上似乎快冒烟了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looks like the top of Yvette's head might start steaming.)

TextContext.SourceString: （按着伊薇特的肩膀让她冷静下来，认真地询问。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Gently placing a hand on Yvette's shoulder to calm her down, I asked sincerely.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特，冷静下来，感受内心真实的想法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, calm down, and feel out your true thoughts.

TextContext.SourceString: 真的不愿意自己进行测试吗？我会陪着你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you really not want to test this? I’m here with you.

TextContext.SourceString: （看着系在伊薇特手上的徽章颜色慢慢变化，从紧张的通红慢慢过渡到鲜艳的明黄，最后定格在一张灿烂的黄色笑脸上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Watching the badge on Yvette's wrist, the color gradually changes from a tense red to a vibrant bright yellow, finally settling on a radiant yellow smiley face.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……这……好吧。被自己发明的设备看穿了呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I guess...okay. Caught by my own invention.

TextContext.SourceString: ……确实，由发明者来测试设备，数据应该是最准确的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Indeed, having the inventor test the device yields the best data...

TextContext.SourceString: ……而且，哪怕伊薇特展现出完全陌生的情绪，引航者也会好好接住的，对吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...And even if I show strange emotions, the Navigator will handle it well, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 一定会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Absolutely.

TextContext.SourceString: 我也对这些情绪充满好奇。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'd be intrigued by those emotions too.

TextContext.SourceString: 那……那就出发吧！今天，引航者是伊薇特的“高级测试员”……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then... let's go! Today, Navigator is my "Senior Tester"…!

TextParam.SourceString: 和伊薇特度过了冒险一般的奇妙夜晚，收集到了“过于丰富”的数据，但总体很开心。
TextParam.LocalizedString: (Spent a night that felt like an adventure with Yvette, gathering more data than we could handle, but it was genuinely fun overall.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在最后分别时，伊薇特把设备放进了我的口袋。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As we parted ways, Yvette slipped the device into my pocket.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这个……留给我吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this… for me?

TextContext.SourceString: 我需要的只是数据，设备会不断升级……这个送给引航者，当做“感谢”还是“礼物”，都可以哦……
TextContext.LocalizedString: All I need is the data. The device will keep evolving... This is for you, Navigator, as either "thanks" or a "gift," it’s up to you...

TextContext.SourceString: 以后如果伊薇特又想藏起来，麻烦引航者用它敲敲伊薇特的脑袋……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: If I ever try to hide again, please give me a tap on the head with it...!

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟，约好了对引航者只说真心话的……伊薇特一定会遵守。
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, I promised to always speak from the heart with you… I’ll keep that promise.

TextContext.SourceString: （收好圆形徽章，目送伊薇特离开。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I tuck away the circular badge and watch as Yvette walks away.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……我边找边想，可是根本想不到菲离家出走的原因……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've tried to think of why Fay might have run away, but I can't figure it out...

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么办……引航者……我不会无意间做了让菲生气的事情吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What should I do, Navigator? Did I accidentally do something to make him upset...?

TextContext.SourceString: 菲主动切断通讯的情况，以前从来没有发生过……
TextContext.LocalizedString: He's never cut off communication like this before...

TextContext.SourceString: （电话那头的伊薇特听起来急得快哭了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette sounded like she was about to cry over the phone.)

TextContext.SourceString: 别急，我们会找到菲的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't worry, we'll find Fay.

TextContext.SourceString: 在那之前，我不会挂断电话，安心。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Until then, I won't hang up. Stay calm.

TextContext.SourceString: 呜……好的……街心花园这一片都没有，东区也已经找遍了，引航者那边情况如何？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sniff... okay... I’ve checked the central park and the eastern district already, how's it going on your end?

TextContext.SourceString: 有点棘手。西区没找到，路人也都说没看到。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a bit tricky. No sign of him in the west district, and the locals haven't seen anything.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们在商业街汇合吧，一起想想办法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's meet up on the main street and think of a plan together.

TextContext.SourceString: 好……只能先这样了……你、你不要挂电话啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fine... that's all we can do for now... just, don't hang up on me...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特的焦虑似乎实体化，经过通讯设备传达给了我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette's anxiety seemed to radiate through the communication device to me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我一边安慰着电话那头的伊薇特，一边逡巡着四周，同时马不停蹄地往商业街赶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I reassured Yvette over the phone, I scanned the surroundings and hurried toward the main street.)

TextContext.SourceString: （保护欲旺盛的机器熊，唯一一次主动断开和主人的链接——此中的原因，我也很好奇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A protective robot bear, breaking links with its owner for the first time—I was curious about the reason, too.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我……我到商业街入口了……呼……现在……来找你……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm... at the entrance to the main street now... whew... I'll find you...

TextContext.SourceString: 人也太多了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: There are so many people...

TextContext.SourceString: 我也到街角了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm at the corner.

TextContext.SourceString: 别跑得太急，慢慢来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't rush, take it slow.

TextContext.SourceString: （商业街虽然算不上摩肩擦踵，但想要在其中迅速找到目标还是挺难的，即使这个目标是一只熊——呃。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The main street wasn’t exactly bustling, but finding someone quickly was still a challenge, even if that someone was a bear—er.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一只熊确实挺好找的……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Well, a bear should be easy to spot...)

TextContext.SourceString: 找到了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Found him!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？！找到菲了吗？在哪里！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh?! You found Fay? Where?

TextContext.SourceString: 在奶茶店门口，和一群小孩子玩……
TextContext.LocalizedString: At the bubble tea shop entrance, playing with some kids...

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，不是在玩，是被围攻了啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, not playing—being swarmed!

TextContext.SourceString: 围攻？怎么会……呜，菲……我来救你了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Swarmed? No way... sniff, Fay... I’m coming to save you!

TextContext.SourceString: 这怎么有只落单的机器熊啊？快来陪我们玩！
TextContext.LocalizedString: How come there's a lonely robot bear? Come play with us!

TextContext.SourceString: 这个熊还戴着帽子，能摘下来不……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This bear’s wearing a hat; can we take it off...?

TextContext.SourceString: 奶茶！这只熊拎着奶茶诶 ！还是限定版的冰山熔岩薄荷巧克力奶茶！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bubble tea! The bear's got bubble tea! And it's the exclusive Ice Mint Choco Volcano version!

TextContext.SourceString: 我是小孩，送我！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm a kid, give it to me!

TextContext.SourceString: （这，熊被熊孩子包围了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The bear was surrounded by a bunch of rowdy kids...)

TextContext.SourceString: 检测到敌意，进入自我保护模式——即将采取主动行为：进攻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Detecting hostility, initiating self-protection mode—about to engage...

TextContext.SourceString: 菲，不可以！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay, no!

TextContext.SourceString: 爪下留人！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold your paws!

TextContext.SourceString: （电光火石之间，一道白色的身影闪现到了我跟前。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In a flash, Yvette appeared before me in a blur of white.)

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特喘着气，张开双臂挡在菲和那群熊孩子之间。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She panted, arms outstretched, shielding Fay from the kids.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不可以……欺负……最珍贵的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't... bully... what's most precious...

TextContext.SourceString: 你是谁呀！为什么要拦着我们和熊玩！让开！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who are you? Why stop us from playing with the bear? Move!

TextContext.SourceString: 是熊的主人吗？能把它的帽子摘下来看看不？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you the owner? Can we take the bear's hat off?

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……奶茶……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Um... the bubble tea...
Huff... Huff...

TextContext.SourceString: （努力平复着呼吸的伊薇特显然无法应付这种状况，但好在她靠近后，菲停止了攻击动作。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Though Yvette struggled to catch her breath, her presence calmed Fay’s aggressive stance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 熊孩子们，不许再欺负熊了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kids, stop bullying the bear!

TextContext.SourceString: 再闹下去，抓你们去见家长！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Keep this up, and I'll take you to your parents!

TextContext.SourceString: 呃啊，是大人！什么时候出现的？快跑啊——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah! It's an adult! Run!

TextContext.SourceString: ……啊，消失了呢，像一阵风一样。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, they vanished, like the wind...

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特刚刚也像一阵风。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, you were like the wind just now, too.

TextContext.SourceString: 以后就叫你欧泊小闪电吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: From now on, you'll be the Lightning Flash of P.U.S.

TextContext.SourceString: 请不要取笑伊薇特……我只是太着急了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please, don't tease Yvette... I was just too worried...

TextContext.SourceString: 菲……你还好吧，有没有受伤？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay... are you alright? Are you hurt?

TextContext.SourceString: （用力摇头）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Shakes head emphatically)

TextContext.SourceString: 可以告诉我你切断通讯离家出走的原因吗……我，我是不是做了什么让你不高兴的事……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can you tell me why you cut communication and ran away...? Was it something I did...?

TextContext.SourceString: （疑惑地用力摇头）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Shakes head confusedly)

TextContext.SourceString: （突然发现，菲似乎把什么东西藏在身后……？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I suddenly noticed Fay seemed to be hiding something behind him...)

TextContext.SourceString: 菲好像有东西要给你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay seems to have something for you.

TextContext.SourceString: （菲打开包装袋，把两杯奶茶递给了伊薇特，还顺爪指了指我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fay opened a bag, handing two bubble teas to Yvette, and pointed at me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 奶茶……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bubble tea...?

TextContext.SourceString: 这个颜色，是线下限定款……还是只有游乐园门店才有卖的那款……菲，你居然买到了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: This color—it’s the exclusive release... only available at theme park stores... Fay, you actually got this?

TextContext.SourceString: （骄傲地点头）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Nods proudly)

TextContext.SourceString: 那我知道原因了……非、非常对不起！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now I understand... I am so, so sorry!

TextContext.SourceString: 一定是因为上次只有我和引航者喝了奶茶，菲没有喝到，所以生气了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It must have been because only the Navigator and I got bubble tea last time, and Fay didn't have any...

TextContext.SourceString: 之后……我因为社恐，不敢去线下店排队，所以没有买给菲……
TextContext.LocalizedString: After that, I was too shy to queue in-store, so I didn’t get Fay any...

TextContext.SourceString: 都是我的错……菲会生气离家出走，也是理所当然的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It’s all my fault... Fay's anger and running away were justified...

TextContext.SourceString: （愣住，似乎死机了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Stunned, as if frozen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （回忆一下，似乎完全不是她说的那样……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Reflecting, I realized it wasn't quite how she described it...)

TextContext.SourceString: 走了这么久……好累啊……引航者好厉害，还是精神抖擞呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: After walking so much... I'm exhausted... but you, Navigator, are still full of energy...

TextContext.SourceString: 所以说，光宅在家做研究是不行的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: See, just staying home and doing research doesn't cut it!

TextContext.SourceString: 前面有奶茶店，我们去歇一会？
TextContext.LocalizedString: There’s a bubble tea shop ahead. Want to take a break?

TextContext.SourceString: 好。我来看看喝什么……诶，这个是……超级超级热门的薄荷巧克力奶茶！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sure. Let me see what to get... hey, it's... the super-popular Mint Choco Bubble Tea!

TextContext.SourceString: 每次外卖都点不到，我还以为下架了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I could never order this for delivery, thought it was discontinued...

TextContext.SourceString: 不是下架，是因为太火爆，下午四点左右就售罄了喔！今天多订购了一批薄荷叶，才能卖到现在。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not discontinued, it’s just so popular it sells out by 4 PM! Today we ordered extra mint leaves, so it’s still available.

TextContext.SourceString: 这是最后一杯了，你们很幸运呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is the last cup; you're lucky!

TextContext.SourceString: 这么幸运，那我必定拿下！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lucky indeed. I'm definitely taking it!

TextContext.SourceString: （拿着店员打包好的奶茶，和伊薇特一同坐在长椅上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With the packed bubble tea, I sat with Yvette on a bench.)

TextContext.SourceString: （把奶茶递给伊薇特）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I handed the bubble tea to Yvette.)

TextContext.SourceString: 今天辛苦了，你做得很好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've done great today.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶……？明明引航者更辛苦，陪着我找了这么多人做测试……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What... but you've done more, tagging along for so many tests...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果你不能第一口喝到这个超级好喝的冰奶茶的话，冰奶茶也会难过的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you're not the first to taste this super yummy bubble tea, the tea would be sad...

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，请用吧，不要辜负冰奶茶的一片好心哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, please enjoy it, don’t waste the bubble tea's kind intentions...

TextContext.SourceString: （坚持让伊薇特先喝）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I insisted Yvette take the first sip.)

TextContext.SourceString: 好、好吧，这次换我对引航者毫无办法了。不过，如果你不介意的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Okay, I guess I’m no match for the Navigator this time. But if you don't mind...

TextContext.SourceString: 我们可以一起喝吗？伊薇特只喝一点就够了……重要的是，我们分享……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can we share it? Yvette only needs a little... what's important is that we share...

TextContext.SourceString: （少女状似镇定地把奶茶递过来，只是，佩戴在胸口的设备暴露了她紧张羞涩的事实。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette, feigning calm, handed over the bubble tea, though the device on her chest betrayed her nervousness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （喝一口奶茶）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Take a sip of bubble tea)

TextContext.SourceString: 很好喝呢，我很喜欢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It’s really good, I like it!

TextContext.SourceString: 真的吗！……那下次，我们再一起来喝吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really! ... Then next time, let’s come again!

TextContext.SourceString: （看着不断道歉的伊薇特和似乎卡住了进程的菲，我感觉自己不得不做点什么了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Watching Yvette continually apologize and Fay seemingly stuck in a loop, I felt I had to intervene.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特，冷静！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, calm down!

TextContext.SourceString: 要不要听听菲的想法？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How about hearing Fay’s side?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……好。抱歉，我一着急就有点无语伦次……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah... alright. Sorry, when I panic, I lose my words...

TextContext.SourceString: 确实语无伦次……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You do get a bit scattered...

TextContext.SourceString: 这个——感觉你现在很需要。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here—this might help.

TextContext.SourceString: 之前留给你的“超弦体数据可视化设备”……你一直都带在身边吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The "Superstring Data Visualization Device" I left with you... have you been carrying it all along?

TextContext.SourceString: ……我明白了。菲，你想告诉我的，究竟是什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ... I see. Fay, what are you trying to tell me?

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特将设备佩戴在菲的身上。设备开始运转，屏幕上出现不断变化的表情，最后，停在一张心满意足的笑脸上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette placed the device on Fay. It activated, displaying changing expressions that settled on a satisfied smile.)

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……？这，菲，你是很高兴吗？数据显示……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh...? Fay, you’re happy? The data shows...

TextContext.SourceString: 喜悦值78，骄傲值64，宽慰值80……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Joy level 78, pride level 64, comfort level 80...

TextContext.SourceString: 出现了陌生的情绪……为什么呢，不是很理解……
TextContext.LocalizedString: A new emotion appeared... why...? I don't quite understand...

TextContext.SourceString: ……下次迭代时要更加注意信息的传达性了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ... I must be more attentive in conveying information next time I iterate.

TextContext.SourceString: 看到这个数据，我有个想法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Seeing those stats, I have an idea.

TextContext.SourceString: 要不然，让菲先听听看？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Maybe Fay could hear it first?

TextParam.SourceString: 将自己关于菲行为的猜测说了出来，期间，菲频频点头，最后竖起了大拇指。
TextParam.LocalizedString: (I shared my theory about Fay's actions; Fay nodded repeatedly, then gave a thumbs-up.)

TextContext.SourceString: “上次我和引航者分享奶茶时，设备记录到我出现了从未有过的高喜悦值”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: "Last time I shared bubble tea with the Navigator, my device recorded high joy levels never seen before"...

TextContext.SourceString: “认为这是奶茶的功劳，因此给我和引航者各买了一杯……”
TextContext.LocalizedString: "Considering this was because of the bubble tea, bought a cup each for me and the Navigator..."

TextContext.SourceString: “想要看到……我们更开心的样子”……是这样吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: "Wanted to see... us happier..." Is that right?

TextContext.SourceString: （鼓掌）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We applauded.)
Fay...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特突然紧紧抱住了菲。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette suddenly hugged Fay tightly.)

TextContext.SourceString: 菲是全世界最——好最好的伙伴……感受到了菲的在意，我很开心……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay is the best partner in the world... I felt Fay’s care, and I’m really happy...

TextContext.SourceString: 不过……心跳加速、数值飙升什么的……也不全是因为奶茶……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But... the accelerated heartbeat, the soaring numbers... it’s not all because of the bubble tea...

TextContext.SourceString: 哦？那是因为什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? Then what's the reason?

TextContext.SourceString: 该不会是因为和我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could it be because of me...?

TextContext.SourceString: 引引引航者——快喝奶茶吧！那个，菲的心意，请务必……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Na-Na-Navigator—drink your tea! Um, please enjoy Fay’s gesture...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特红着脸，语无伦次地打断了我，以把奶茶塞到我手里的方式。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette, face flushed and stumbling over her words, cut me off by handing over the tea.)

TextContext.SourceString: （今天的奶茶，也是如此的美味香甜啊。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Today’s bubble tea is indeed deliciously sweet.)

TextContext.SourceString: 是理查德先生吗……这里是欧泊技术中心……我想请问……之前订购的一批设备……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mr. Richards...? This is P.U.S Tech Center... I wanted to ask about the batch of equipment we ordered...

TextContext.SourceString: ……什么时候……给我们……送来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: When... can we expect... delivery...

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特？你声音怎么怪怪的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette? You sound a bit off.

TextContext.SourceString: 听上去就像……快睡着了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's like you're... about to fall asleep?

TextContext.SourceString: …………！！！我，我是谁，我在哪，发生了什么，我为什么会……拿着电话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...!!! Who am I, where am I, what's happening, and why am I... holding the phone...

TextContext.SourceString: （电话那头，少女昏昏欲睡的声音瞬间清醒。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (On the other end, Yvette's sleepy voice instantly snapped to alertness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而且，我从没有听伊薇特用这——么快的语速说话过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Besides, I’ve never heard Yvette speak so fast before.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……？我不是要打给设备制造商吗……？为什么会拨出你的号码……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator...? Wasn't I calling the equipment supplier...? Why are you on the line...

TextContext.SourceString: 你听上去很累。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You sound exhausted.

TextContext.SourceString: 最近有好好休息吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you been getting enough rest lately?

TextContext.SourceString: 大、大概有……对不起，打扰了……之后我会再来致歉的……现在，要先给理查德先生打过去……
TextContext.LocalizedString: M-Maybe... I'm sorry for the bother... I'll apologize properly later... I have to call Mr. Richards now...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特急匆匆挂断了电话，让人有些担心她的精神状态。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette hung up in a hurry, leaving me worried about her mental state.)

TextContext.SourceString: （还是去一趟欧泊看看情况吧，可别出什么事了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I should head to P.U.S and check on her—better make sure everything's okay...)​

TextContext.SourceString: (来到欧泊基地，在前台登记好身份信息后，我向着伊薇特工作的楼层走去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After registering at the front desk, I headed up to Yvette's work floor.)

TextContext.SourceString: （远远地，就看到伊薇特正在和一个穿着制服的女人交谈。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (From a distance, I spotted Yvette talking to a woman in a uniform.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这次的文件没错了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The documents are correct this time, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 不会有错的，我……我检查了三遍！刚刚真的是个意外……
TextContext.LocalizedString: There won't be any mistakes, I... I checked them three times! What happened earlier was really just a one-off...

TextContext.SourceString: 好吧，下次注意哦，小伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, just be careful next time, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: （穿着制服的女人走开了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The woman in uniform walked away.)

TextContext.SourceString: 唉……明明不想这样的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sigh... I really didn’t mean for this to happen...

TextContext.SourceString: ……伊薇特，你怎么又犯这种错误了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, how could you mess up like this again...

TextContext.SourceString: 什么错误？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mess up how?

TextContext.SourceString: 不想怎样？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What don’t you want to happen?

TextContext.SourceString: ……吓！引航者？我是在做梦吗……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Ah! Navigator? Am I dreaming...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特伸出手，捏了捏我的脸。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette reached out and pinched my face.)

TextContext.SourceString: 觉得在做梦的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you think you're dreaming...

TextContext.SourceString: 应该捏自己的脸才对吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shouldn't you be pinching yourself?

TextContext.SourceString: 好像也对……那引航者可以捏一下我的脸，我看看会不会痛……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That makes sense... but maybe you could pinch my cheek, let me see if it's real...

TextContext.SourceString: （伸出手，但最后只是摸了摸伊薇特的头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I reached out, but ended up just patting her on the head.)

TextContext.SourceString: 好舒服……又有点昏昏欲睡了呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's nice... it's making me sleepy again...

TextContext.SourceString: 你最近是完全没睡觉吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haven't you been sleeping at all?

TextContext.SourceString: 你的状态已经影响到工作了哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your work is suffering because of this, you know.

TextContext.SourceString: 没关系，很快就下班了……今晚我会争取早点睡……尽量……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's okay, I'm almost off work for today... I’ll try to sleep earlier tonight... hopefully...

TextContext.SourceString: 真的……很对不起……我一定会更加谨慎……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really... I'm so sorry... I’ll be more careful...

TextContext.SourceString: 今天，非常抱歉……让你担心了……还专门过来确认伊薇特的状况……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you... for checking on me... coming all this way to make sure I'm okay...

TextContext.SourceString: 光是道歉可没有用。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Apologies alone aren't enough.

TextContext.SourceString: 必须要用实际行动偿还！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Actions speak louder, so let's see some proof!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……？那要怎么办……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh...? What should I do...

TextContext.SourceString: 我睡眠警察今天就要出警——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Time for the Sleep Police to step in—

TextContext.SourceString: 将不好好睡觉的伊薇特捉拿归案——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyone not sleeping well will be brought in—

TextContext.SourceString: ……诶！要带我去哪里……走、走得太快了，请慢一点……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Huh! Where are you taking me... you're too fast, slow down...

TextParam.SourceString: 就这样，用比平常稍微强硬些的态度，将伊薇特带出了欧泊。
TextParam.LocalizedString: (With a firmer approach than usual, I escorted Yvette out of P.U.S.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一路上引来了不少人的侧目……可能也是因此，伊薇特干脆地没有反抗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We caught quite the attention, but Yvette didn't resist, perhaps being too caught up in her own embarrassment.)

TextContext.SourceString: （否则，引发的动静也太大了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Otherwise, it would've caused a bigger scene.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm...

TextContext.SourceString: 没生气吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're not mad, are you...?

TextContext.SourceString: 完全不生气……只是刚刚一路上，太多人盯着我们……有点害羞。所以，偷偷隐身起来了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not angry at all... just a bit embarrassed with everyone staring at us... so I went invisible for a bit...

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者的心意，伊薇特明白。但这个问题没有那么容易解决。伊薇特尝试过很多次……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I understand your intentions, Navigator. But it's not an easy fix. I've tried so many times...

TextContext.SourceString: 该怎么说呢……过去很久了……还在困扰着……
TextContext.LocalizedString: How do I put this... it’s a struggle that’s been lingering for a long time...

TextContext.SourceString: （看着伊薇特纠结的表情，用眼神安慰她不用着急。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing Yvette's conflicted expression, I offered a reassuring look to calm her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 唔……这样，我带引航者去一个地方吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... let me take you somewhere.

TextContext.SourceString: 可能在那里，我会更放松些。也可能，引航者这么聪明的人，都不需要我多解释……就能猜出来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Maybe there, I'll feel more at ease. And you’re so smart, you probably don’t even need me to explain much...

TextContext.SourceString: 好，听你的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sure, lead the way.

TextContext.SourceString: （车来之后，伊薇特给司机报上了一个完全陌生的地址。)
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After the car arrived, Yvette gave the driver an address I’d never heard of.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然很好奇，但还是耐心等待着，直到车最终停在一个稍显老旧的小区门口。)
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Curious but patient, I waited as we arrived at an older neighborhood.)

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特轻车熟路地带着我在小区里绕行，最后从口袋里取出钥匙……进入了一户人家里。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette navigated the complex with familiarity, reaching into her pocket for a key... and unlocking an apartment.)

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然有些陈旧……但一直有来清理……所以，应该没有什么灰尘。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a bit old... but I come to clean often... so there shouldn’t be any dust.

TextContext.SourceString: 欢迎来到伊薇特的“家”——啊，我是说，真正的“家”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Welcome to Yvette's "home"—I mean, my real "home."

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者的表情有些意外呢……是觉得，像伊薇特这样的人，有一个“家”很奇怪吗……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You look surprised... is it strange for someone like me to have a "home"?

TextContext.SourceString: 完全不奇怪，只是没有想到。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not strange at all, just unexpected.

TextContext.SourceString: “伊薇特”和“菲”，已经像“家”一样完整了哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In a way, you and Fay together already feel like a complete "home."

TextContext.SourceString: 因为，菲现在是我仅剩的家人了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Because Fay is my only family left now...

TextContext.SourceString: 你现在还会回这个“家”吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you still come back to this "home"?

TextContext.SourceString: 会……但是次数不太多，一直睡不着的时候，心会跳得很快，在这里，能比较放松下来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I do... but not often. When I can't sleep and my heart races, I come here to relax...

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么会睡不着呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why can't you sleep?

TextContext.SourceString: 以前没发现你有这样的状况。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Never noticed this about you before.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，那是因为，只有在某个特定日子到来的时候，才会睡不着……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, that's because it only happens around a certain time each year...

TextContext.SourceString: 我也不知道该怎么形容，大概是创伤过后的……应激障碍……？诊断书上是这么说的，我也是这么感觉的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m not sure how to explain. Maybe it’s post-traumatic... stress disorder...? That’s what the diagnosis says, and that’s how it feels...

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者有过这种感觉吗？想要逃避一件事，但每个逃避的行为，都是再一次的提醒……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you ever wanted to avoid something, but every attempt to escape just reminds you more...

TextContext.SourceString: 很想忘掉。但这种刻意的强调，会变成，像淤泥一样，让人陷进去的存在……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You long to forget, but the effort to bury it only deepens the feeling, like sinking in quicksand...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特……似乎有些伤心。尽管她已经在刻意压制这种情绪了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette... seemed sad. Even though she tried hard to suppress it.)

TextContext.SourceString: 一般来说，等这段时间过去就好了。我都藏得很好，不会给大家带来麻烦！今天……唔……今天是特殊情况……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It usually passes with time. I hide it well so it doesn’t trouble anyone! Today... well, today was different...

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特一直都很努力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You always put in so much effort.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以没有人会因此责怪伊薇特的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No one’s blaming you for this.

TextContext.SourceString: ……那就好。不因此给其他人添麻烦的话，我就安心了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...That’s good. As long as I’m not a bother, that’s a relief.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者是有魔力吗……简简单单的几句话，就能安慰到我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, you must have some magic... a few words from you are enough to comfort me.

TextContext.SourceString: 心情放松下来后，甚至有一点点想睡觉……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Feeling relaxed now even makes me a little sleepy...

TextContext.SourceString: 那要不要趁现在睡一下？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Maybe you should nap while you can?

TextContext.SourceString: 我可以暂时代替菲，成为守护伊薇特梦境的小熊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’ll be Fay's stand-in, watching over your dreams.

TextContext.SourceString: 守护梦境的……小熊？那是什么……
TextContext.LocalizedString: A dream guardian... bear? What's that supposed to mean...

TextContext.SourceString: （绘声绘色地和伊薇特讲述了自己编造的故事。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I spun a charming tale for Yvette.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在人们睡着后，隐藏在黑暗中的奇怪生物就会突然出现，试图夺走他们的美梦。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Strange creatures lurk in the shadows, waiting to steal people’s dreams as they sleep.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而此时，他们床头的小熊玩偶则会苏醒，拿起盾牌与剑，为了保护人们的梦境与怪物搏斗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But their bedside teddy bears awaken, wielding sword and shield, defending those dreams.)

TextContext.SourceString: 原来如此。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么……我想要感受一下，名为“引航者”的小熊骑士，为我守护的梦境……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then... I’d love to see how the Navigator bear protects my dreams.

TextContext.SourceString: （肩上突然传来温热的重量——伊薇特把头靠在了我肩上，合上了眼，呼吸缓慢而平静。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Suddenly, she leaned her head on my shoulder, closing her eyes, her breathing soft and calm.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看起来，小熊骑士得到了充分的信任呢。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looks like the Ser Teddy earned full trust.)

TextContext.SourceString: （过了好一会儿，伊薇特才悠悠转醒。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a while, Yvette finally stirred awake.)

TextContext.SourceString: 怎……怎么真的睡着了？只是想小憩五分钟……我……我一直趴在引航者肩头吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wha... was I really asleep? I meant to rest for just five minutes... I... I leaned on your shoulder this whole time?

TextContext.SourceString: 肩膀……应该很酸吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your shoulder... must be sore, huh?

TextContext.SourceString: （试着活动肩膀，果然发出了“咔哒”的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I rolled my shoulder—it made a loud click.)

TextContext.SourceString: 因为怕把伊薇特惊醒。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't want to wake you.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过你睡得很好。精神好些了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Besides, you slept well. Feeling better?

TextContext.SourceString: 好、好很多了……我，我感觉，从没有这么精力充沛过。真的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Much, much better... I’ve never felt this energized. Really!

TextContext.SourceString: 我的梦境……好像真的被守护了……感觉很安心，才一下睡了这么久。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I truly felt my dreams were safe... It was so comforting, that's probably why I slept so well.

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢你……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you...

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然关于伊薇特的谜团还有很多，但是来日方长。今天，能先解决睡眠的问题就已经很好了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Even though there are still mysteries about Yvette, we have time to figure them out. Solving the sleep issue today is a great start.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我们一起回去吧？明天还要工作，你应该也很忙碌……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shall we head back together? We have work tomorrow, and you must be busy...

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天晚上，方便把通讯设备一直开着吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can you keep your communication on tonight?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……方、方便的！想要找我的话，随时都……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah... of-of course! If you want to reach me, just...

TextContext.SourceString: 你说，今晚……小熊骑士也会守护伊薇特的梦境……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You mean, tonight... Ser Teddy will still watch over my dreams...?

TextContext.SourceString: 觉得，如果有声音陪伴的话，也许会更容易入睡……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: A soothing voice might just help me drift off more easily...

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，一定可以的。我会等着引航者打来的电话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sure of it. I'll be waiting for your call, Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 光是想想，都觉得这会是个无比美妙的梦境呢。我……很期待……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just thinking about it makes me look forward to such a wonderful dream... I... can't wait...

TextContext.SourceString: （送伊薇特回到了欧泊的宿舍。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I led Yvette back to her dorm at P.U.S.)

TextContext.SourceString: （希望今晚的她，能做个好梦。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Here’s to hoping she dreams sweetly tonight.)

TextContext.SourceString: 唔……这周日是吗？我看一下，没有工作安排……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... this Sunday? Let me check... No work scheduled...

TextContext.SourceString: 私人行程吗……也、也没有……嗯，我会把那一天空出来的！毕竟这可是引航者的邀约，很珍贵……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Personal plans? Um, nope... I'll keep the day open then! After all, an invitation from you, Navigator, is precious...

TextContext.SourceString: 好奇……？有一点吧……不过更多的是期待！不管和引航者一起去哪里，都一定会是美妙的经历吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Curious? A bit, yeah... but honestly, I'm more excited! No matter where we go, it's bound to be a wonderful experience with you.

TextContext.SourceString: 那……就约定好了哦？ 下周日不见不散。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... it's a date then? Next Sunday it is.

TextContext.SourceString: （挂断电话，不禁长舒一口气。言谈中，感觉伊薇特并没有意识到“这周日”的特别之处。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I hung up the phone, breathing a sigh of relief. It seemed Yvette hadn't realized the significance of "this Sunday.")

TextContext.SourceString: （回想起上次送伊薇特回家时，她告诉我的那些事情……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Recalling what she had shared last time about her past...)

TextContext.SourceString: 吹一下夜晚的海风……感觉头脑都变清醒了呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The evening sea breeze... it's really clearing my head.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……刚刚，我睡着的时候，应该没有做出什么……丢、丢脸的事吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator... while I was asleep earlier, I didn't do anything... embarrassing, did I?

TextContext.SourceString: 比如说梦话……之类的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Like talking in my sleep... or anything like that...

TextContext.SourceString: 有哦，我还录音了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, you did. I even recorded it.

TextContext.SourceString: 真的假的……伊薇特，也听不到自己的梦话啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really...? Yvette can't hear her own sleep-talking, though...

TextContext.SourceString: 应该没有像电影里那样，嘴里喊着“爸爸妈妈”，流着泪醒来吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hopefully it wasn't like the movies, crying and calling out "Mom and Dad" in my sleep, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 应该不太可能。毕竟，就连还是真正小孩子的我，也只花了很短的时间，就适应了那样的状况。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Probably not. Even as a little kid, I adjusted to it pretty quickly.

TextContext.SourceString: 这么算起来，爸爸妈妈离开我的时间……已经和他们陪伴我的时间差不多久了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thinking about it, the time since Mom and Dad left me is almost as long as the time they spent with me.

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette...

TextContext.SourceString: 他们去哪里了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Where did they go?

TextContext.SourceString: 我不知道……他们在某一天的早上，毫无征兆地消失了。他们的研究资料，也被带走了。所以，应该不会回来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don’t know... One morning they just vanished without a trace. Even their research notes disappeared. So, they probably aren’t coming back.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，征兆……非要说的话，妈妈从来没有送过我礼物。但是在那之前的一个星期，妈妈把菲，送给了我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, if there was any sign... Mom never gave me gifts, but a week before they left, she gave me Fay.

TextContext.SourceString: 菲，是“我”和“过去”，唯一的联系了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay is my only link to the "past"...

TextContext.SourceString: 他们在研究什么，你知道吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you know what they were researching?

TextContext.SourceString: 太奇怪了……这样的行为。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It all seems so strange...

TextContext.SourceString: 不知道。他们有意避开了我。之前工作的研究所，也搬迁走了。偶尔会有同事阿姨来看我，但也只是看看……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have no idea. They kept me out of it. Their workplace moved away too. Occasionally, a colleague of theirs would check on me...

TextContext.SourceString: 他们也不知道，我的爸爸妈妈去了哪里。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even they don't know where my parents went.

TextContext.SourceString: 爸爸妈妈离开，是为了保护伊薇特。这样的原因……很多人都说过。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They left to protect Yvette, so they say... Many people told me that.

TextContext.SourceString: 我没有不接受这种可能……我只是……接受了，还是会难过。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't reject that possibility... Being okay with it still makes me sad though.

TextContext.SourceString: 快要到他们离开的那个日子了……每年的这段时间，伊薇特都会很焦虑，很……害怕……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even though it’s just me and Fay now and I won't be abandoned by "family" again... Why am I still scared...

TextContext.SourceString: 明明……明明现在只有伊薇特和菲，再也不会被“家人”抛弃了……为什么……还是会害怕呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 这不是伊薇特的错！
TextContext.LocalizedString: This isn't your fault!

TextContext.SourceString: 不要因为别人的错误惩罚自己！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You shouldn’t punish yourself for others’ mistakes!

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯……我知道……我在努力了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah... I know... I'm trying...

TextContext.SourceString: 你可以……试着再相信我一次。
TextContext.LocalizedString: How about... giving me another chance to earn your trust?

TextContext.SourceString: 相信……引航者？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Trust... in the Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 我不会离开伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I won't leave you, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 我不会让你失望。我保证。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I promise you won't be disappointed.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，不要再害怕了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, please don’t be afraid anymore.
...Okay.

TextContext.SourceString: （之前托人打听到了一些和伊薇特童年经历相关的地点……虽然，她不一定记得了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I had previously looked into some places related to Yvette’s childhood... She might not remember them.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是，一定要让伊薇特度过完美的今天，让她之后无论怎么回想……都只能想起美好的回忆。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Nevertheless, I want to ensure today is perfect for Yvette, so all she recalls are happy memories.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，这边这边……你来得刚刚好呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, over here, over here... You’re just in time.

TextContext.SourceString: 没有等很久，我也刚到。今天很多人出门逛街……担心你找不到我，所以才一直在路口等着。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn’t wait long, I just got here too. Everyone’s out shopping today... Afraid you might miss me, so I stayed by the entrance.

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么不隐身……对、对哦……可能是因为我们已经来过一次了？就是为设备收集数据那次……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why not go invisible... Oh, right... it might be because we’ve been here once before? For collecting data on equipment...

TextContext.SourceString: 因为采访了很多路人，情不自禁就感觉……这里非常地……亲切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: After talking to so many people, I can't help but feel... a special fondness for this place.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以……今天的引航者想要做些什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... what’s on the agenda today, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 狠狠购物！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shopping spree!

TextContext.SourceString: 狠狠逛街！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's hit the stores hard!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶……是最近星庇所工作压力太大了……？还以为，只有我会用购物来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh... been too stressed at Astral Sanctuary lately...? I thought I was the only one who shopped to... Ah... never mind...

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……没、没什么……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah... never mind...

TextContext.SourceString: 我们快走吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let’s get moving...

TextContext.SourceString: （告诉伊薇特，其实是要给星庇所近期救治过的一批孩子们买些礼物。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I explain to Yvette how we’re picking out gifts for the kids recently cared for by Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而关于收养这批孩子的福利院，当年伊薇特也差点被送过去这件事……还是先瞒着她好了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As for the orphanage adopting these kids, which Yvette almost ended up in... I'll keep that to myself for now.)

TextContext.SourceString: 原来如此……那伊薇特也来帮忙挑选礼物……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see... Then Yvette will help pick out the gifts too...!

TextContext.SourceString: （和伊薇特一起度过了愉快的购物时光，还看到了很适合她的蝴蝶结丝带，偷偷买下来送给她吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We had a great time shopping together, and I picked up a lovely ribbon that suited her perfectly—I'll sneak it in as a gift for her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （买到足够多的礼物后，和伊薇特一同前往位于城郊的福利院。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After getting enough gifts, Yvette and I headed to the orphanage on the outskirts of town.)

TextContext.SourceString: 没有父母和家人的孩子，所共同居住的地方？……和想象中不太一样呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: A place where kids without parents or family live together? ...It’s different from what I imagined...

TextContext.SourceString: （看着被气球和彩带环绕的福利院大门，以及在门口嬉戏打闹的孩童，伊薇特有些惊讶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing the balloons and streamers decorating the orphanage entrance, along with children playing, Yvette seemed surprised.)

TextContext.SourceString: 还以为会像研究所一样，到处都是白色的……很安静，也没有人说话。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I thought it’d be all white and quiet like a research lab, with nobody talking.

TextContext.SourceString: 那些孩子们都在笑……他们看起来，还挺快乐的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But those kids are laughing... They actually look pretty happy.

TextContext.SourceString: 有些父母，并不是为了惩罚孩子才将他们送走。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Some parents don’t send their kids away as punishment.

TextContext.SourceString: 也许，他们也希望孩子过得更好……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Maybe, they're hoping for a better life for their kids too...

TextContext.SourceString: 咦？小熊姐姐，你就是来给我送礼物的人吗！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, Miss Teddy Bear, are you the one bringing me a gift?

TextContext.SourceString: （因为提前和福利院院长打好了招呼，这里的孩子应该知道今天会有人带礼物来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We’d informed the orphanage director in advance that we'd be bringing gifts for the kids today.)

TextContext.SourceString: （只是比起我，戴着小熊兜帽的伊薇特更加吸引他们的注意。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But it seems Yvette, wearing her little bear hood, drew more attention than me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，啊，礼物……是、是的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, um, gifts... y-yes...

TextContext.SourceString: 哇~谢谢姐姐！院长阿姨说，只要在生日前都乖乖的，就能收到好孩子的礼物，院长果然没有骗我~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow! Thank you, Miss! The director said if I'm a good kid before my birthday, I'll get a special gift. The director didn't lie!

TextContext.SourceString: 是你的生日礼物吗？请收好……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here's your birthday gift, please take it...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特把礼物递给小女孩。然后，我眼睁睁看着她的手拿起又放下，在空中虚晃了好几枪后，轻轻地停在小女孩的头顶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette handed a gift to the little girl. I watched as her hand hesitated in mid-air for a moment, then gently patted the girl’s head.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……祝你，生日快乐，希望你，以后也能天天开心……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Happy birthday. I hope you're happy every day...

TextContext.SourceString: （小女孩拉着裙摆，对伊薇特行了个孩子气的公主礼后，一蹦一跳地跑走了。而不远处，她的玩伴们正在向她遥遥招手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The little girl gave Yvette a curtsey and bounced away to join her friends waving from afar.)

TextContext.SourceString: 好可爱……她们看起来感情真好。能在这种地方交到朋友……好厉害……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So adorable... They seem so close. Making friends in a place like this... that's amazing...

TextContext.SourceString: 因为她想要和其他人交朋友。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She wants to make friends with others.

TextContext.SourceString: 你察觉到她的意图后，不也想要主动靠近吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Once you sensed that, didn't you feel drawn to her too?
...Yes.

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特的眼神留恋地在游玩的孩子们身上逡巡。这也是我来福利院调查之后所预想的情况。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette watched the playing children with longing, just as I expected after visiting the orphanage.)

TextContext.SourceString: （如果未来，她偶然间得知自己要被送往的，是这样一个温馨的地方，应该也不会太难受了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (If she ever finds out she was meant to be sent to such a warm place, hopefully, it won't be too upsetting.)

TextContext.SourceString: （接下来，就是另一个重要的、同时也很熟悉的地点……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Next, there’s another important, yet familiar place to visit...)

TextContext.SourceString: （偷偷叮嘱了司机，在到达目的地之前不要暴露地名。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I secretly told the driver not to reveal our destination just yet.)

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，车子怎么不走了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh, why did the car stop...

TextContext.SourceString: 目的地就是这里吗……游乐园？可是，今天不是任何节日，也不是我们的生日……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is the destination really... an amusement park? But it’s not any holiday or either of our birthdays...

TextContext.SourceString: 不是任何特殊的日子也可以来游乐园嘛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who says you need a special occasion to visit the amusement park?

TextContext.SourceString: 你看，这不是很多人吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look, there are plenty of people here!

TextContext.SourceString: 何止是很多……简直是……太多了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: More than just plenty... It’s like a swarm of people...

TextContext.SourceString: 我可以隐身吧……呜，对不起，留引航者一个人应付人这么多的局面……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I should go stealth, right... Oh sorry, leaving you to handle this crowd on your own...

TextContext.SourceString: 我不会离开的，姑且，只是消失一下……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I won’t go far, I’m just gonna... fade out a bit...

TextContext.SourceString: （有些好笑地看着伊薇特抓住我的衣角，露出了抱歉的表情，然后开始试图隐身——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Amused, I watched Yvette grab my sleeve, apologizing as she attempted to go invisible.)

TextContext.SourceString: （——可惜失败了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unfortunately, it didn’t work.)

TextContext.SourceString: （于是，人来人往的游乐园内，伊薇特就这么站在原地，虔诚地似乎在向上天祈祷，嘴里还念念有词。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (So amidst the bustling amusement park, Yvette stood there, earnestly making a wish to the skies, repeating phrases under her breath.)

TextContext.SourceString: 看不见我，看不见我……诶？为什么他们都在盯着我看？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can't see me, can't see me... Huh? Why is everyone staring at me?

TextContext.SourceString: 妈妈，那个姐姐在干嘛啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mommy, what is that lady doing?

TextContext.SourceString: 呃……别人的事你少管！快走快走。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh, that's not our business! Come on, let’s go.

TextContext.SourceString: 噗。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haha.

TextContext.SourceString: 呜……怎么会这样……隐身从来都没有失灵过……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ugh... this never happened before... my stealth isn’t supposed to fail...

TextContext.SourceString: 难道是……我的能力退步了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could it be... my powers are weakening...

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特，冷静。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Calm down, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 你的数据可视化设备一直在闪。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your data display device is blinking non-stop.
Huh?!

TextContext.SourceString: （和伊薇特一起手忙脚乱地把设备取下来后，发现它还在如警报灯般不停闪烁。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Together, we hurriedly removed the device, which continued to blink like an alarm light.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但奇怪的是，它之所以持续亮起，并不是伊薇特出现了某个数值的异常低值，而是因为某个“异常高值”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Strangely, it kept shining not because Yvette showed unusually low metrics, but because of an "unusually high" value instead.)

TextContext.SourceString: （换句话说，设备习惯了平时情绪保持在一个稳定低值，认真理性的伊薇特，它会不习惯这个情绪饱满高昂，很开心的伊薇特。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In other words, it was reacting to Yvette's high spirits and cheerful mood, quite unlike her usual calm and rational demeanor.)

TextContext.SourceString: （嗯……虽然这对伊薇特来说并不是坏事吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Well... it's not necessarily a bad thing for her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （大概？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Probably?)

TextContext.SourceString: 看来暂时没有办法改变这种情况了……隐身，是与生俱来的能力……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Looks like there’s no changing it for now... Being invisible was second nature.

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到有一天，伊薇特还要想着怎么去调整这种能力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But who knew one day I'd have to think about adjusting it...

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry about that, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，引航者要对伊薇特负责……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Which means, you as the Navigator are now responsible for Yvette...!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh?

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，以后要多多陪伴伊薇特。直到，伊薇特不会再因为这份陪伴的特殊，而感到额外的紧张和……喜悦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: From now on, you need to stick around Yvette more. Until the specialness of this company doesn’t make me anxious or... thrilled anymore.

TextContext.SourceString: 这个要求，不算很过分吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It’s not too much to ask, is it?

TextContext.SourceString: （总感觉，伊薇特的性格发生了微妙的变化。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It feels like Yvette's personality's subtly shifting.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但我很确信，这是好的变化。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But I’m sure it’s a positive change.)

TextContext.SourceString: 当然不算。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not at all.

TextContext.SourceString: （最终，忙乱而愉快地结束了今天，收获了满满的回忆。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (And with that, today wraps up with delightful chaos filled with cherished memories.)

TextContext.SourceString: （相信这对于伊薇特来说，是完美的一天。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I believe it was a perfect day for Yvette.)

PrologueTitle.LocalizedString: Promise of the Day of Rebirth

TextContext.SourceString: （一大早接到了伊薇特的短信，希望今天无论如何都过去一趟。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Early this morning, I got a text from Yvette, asking if I could drop by no matter what today.)

TextContext.SourceString: （因此，虽然工作很多，但还是设法尽快完成了。一整天都埋头在工作里，又饿又渴。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Workload’s been heavy, but I managed to power through. Spent the whole day grinding, and now I'm both starved and parched.)

TextContext.SourceString: （终于支撑着疲惫的身体来到了伊薇特的宿舍。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Finally dragging my exhausted self to Yvette's dorm.)

TextContext.SourceString: （咚咚咚）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Knock, knock, knock)

TextContext.SourceString: 来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Coming!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，欢迎！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, welcome!

TextContext.SourceString: （这次是伊薇特而不是菲，在门口迎接我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This time it’s Yvette greeting me at the door, not Fay.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你……你看上去好像很累的样子，是今天的工作特别多吗？嘴唇也发白……你需要补充水分。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You... you look really tired. Was there a lot of work today? Your lips are pale... you should drink some water.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，刚好有那个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, I've got just the thing...

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette!

TextContext.SourceString: 跑那么快……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Running like that...

TextContext.SourceString: 将、将将——这是伊薇特自制的冰奶茶，引航者，请用吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ta-da! This is Yvette's homemade iced milk tea. Please enjoy, Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然……大概没有那家店的限定奶茶好喝……不过，应该也能入口……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Though... it's probably not as good as the limited-edition tea from that shop... but it should still be drinkable...

TextContext.SourceString: 不，或许比那个还好喝也说不定……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, maybe it's even better than that one...

TextContext.SourceString: 将将？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whoa, what?

TextContext.SourceString: 你是谁，把真正的伊薇特还给我！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Where's the real Yvette? Bring her back!

TextContext.SourceString: 不喜欢……？我又弄巧成拙了吗……上次的店员姐姐把奶茶递给我时就是这么说的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You don't like it...? Did I mess up again...? That's what the store clerk said when she handed me the milk tea last time...

TextContext.SourceString: 我错了，我开玩笑的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: My bad,  just messing with you!

TextContext.SourceString: 这样的伊薇特很可爱！
TextContext.LocalizedString: This Yvette is super cute!

TextContext.SourceString: 好，好吧……如果是玩笑的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, okay... if it's just a joke...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果你把这整杯都喝完，并且夸好喝的话，伊薇特就不生气……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you drink the whole cup and say it's delicious, Yvette won't be upset...

TextContext.SourceString: （接过伊薇特手上的冰奶茶，大喝了一口。希望不要是什么奇怪口味的饮料……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I take the iced milk tea from Yvette and gulp it down. Hoping it’s not some bizarre flavor...)

TextContext.SourceString: （冰凉又甜蜜的液体顺着喉管进入胃里，顺便湿润了干燥的嘴唇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The chill and sweetness slide down my throat, soothing my parched lips.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就像在烈日之下无处遁逃时，突然寻觅到一处阴凉地那般清爽宜人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Like finding a shady oasis under a blazing sun—utterly refreshing.)

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么、怎么样……！好喝吗！看你的表情，起码应该不难喝……
TextContext.LocalizedString: H-how is it...? Is it good? Mmm, your expression, at least it's not terrible...

TextContext.SourceString: 你说，这是你喝过最好喝的奶茶？不会在骗我吧……还没有其他人喝过，所以……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You say this is the best milk tea you've ever had? You're not just saying that, right...? No one else has tried it, so...

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者喜欢就太好了……你说上次的奶茶好喝，我努力在模仿它的味道……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm so glad you like it, Navigator...! You said last time that the milk tea was good, so I tried to replicate its flavor...

TextContext.SourceString: 看来为“特别日子”准备的“特别冰饮”，很成功呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It seems like the "special iced drink" I prepared for the "special day" was a success.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天是什么特别日子吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is there something special about today?

TextContext.SourceString: 印象中好像……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I feel like there should be something...

TextContext.SourceString: 是伊薇特的新生日哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's Yvette's "new birthday."

TextContext.SourceString: 不……不是新的生日啦！伊薇特对自己的生日很满意……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No... it's not a new birthday! Yvette is quite happy with her current birthday...!

TextContext.SourceString: 是，新生的日子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's the day of rebirth.

TextContext.SourceString: （少女的眼神不再如往日般，总是游移闪躲，而是温柔又坚定地看着我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her eyes are no longer darting around as before; they’re warmly and firmly fixed on me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 昨晚睡觉前，本来也该和引航者互道晚安……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before going to sleep last night, I should have said goodnight to you, Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 但我太困了，就像晕过去一样睡着了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I was so tired, I just fell asleep as if I’d passed out.

TextContext.SourceString: 醒来之后，发现通讯设备的最后一条信息，是来自引航者的……“晚安”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When I woke up, I saw the last message on my communicator was from you, Navigator... "Goodnight."

TextContext.SourceString: 我感觉，很温暖，很安心……甚至，都忘记了今天，是那个我曾经最害怕到来的日子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I felt so warm and at ease... I almost forgot that today is the day I used to fear the most.

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特好像变了……变成了崭新的伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette seems to have changed... into a brand new Yvette!

TextContext.SourceString: （摸摸伊薇特的头）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Gently pats Yvette's head)

TextContext.SourceString: 这种喜悦的心情……想要立刻和引航者分享！引航者也说过，我可以对你“相信”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This joyful feeling... I wanted to share it with you right away! You did say that I could "trust" you...

TextContext.SourceString: 我相信，引航者能理解我。我也相信……引航者，一定很愿意在这个时刻，陪着我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I trust that you'll understand me, Navigator. I also believe... you're more than willing to share this moment with me.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……我终于在往前走啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator... I'm finally moving forward.

TextContext.SourceString: 新生日快乐，伊薇特。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Happy rebirth day, Yvette.

TextContext.SourceString: 以后，我们一起庆祝更多美好的日子吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let’s celebrate many more wonderful days together from now on.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm!

TextContext.SourceString: 咚咚咚——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ding dong!

TextContext.SourceString: 引、引航者，早上好！为什么这么早就来拜访了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: G-Good morning, Navigator! What brings you here so early...?

TextContext.SourceString: 昨晚熬夜工作了，家里还没收拾……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I stayed up working late last night, so my place is a bit messy...

TextContext.SourceString: 实际上，我是来找菲的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Actually, I'm here to see Fay.

TextContext.SourceString: 菲说有点事要和我商量。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay mentioned wanting to discuss something with me.

TextContext.SourceString: 原来如此，我这就把菲叫过来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see, let me call Fay over to help.

TextContext.SourceString: （面对着伊薇特好奇的眼神，我和菲面面相觑，原本准备的惊喜流程，就这么卡住了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Faced with Yvette's curious eyes, Fay and I exchanged glances. The surprise we had planned seemed to have hit a snag.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我们要说的这件事，
TextContext.LocalizedString: What we're talking about...

TextContext.SourceString: 暂时不能让第三个人知道。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's kind of a secret for nowm, so...

TextContext.SourceString: （硬着头皮把话说出口，果不其然，伊薇特脸上露出了惊慌的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Steeling myself for what I had to say, I watched as Yvette's face filled with concern.)

TextContext.SourceString: 啊？原来是伊薇特不能听的事……对不起！我马上闭上眼睛，捂住耳朵……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? It's something Yvette shouldn't hear... I'm sorry! I'll close my eyes and cover my ears right away...

TextContext.SourceString: 不不，果然我还是先走吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, no, maybe I should just step out for a bit...

TextContext.SourceString: （伊薇特转过身，一副想要逃跑的样子，我连忙叫住她。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yvette turned as if to run, and I quickly stopped her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 别走，接下来的环节可不能少了你！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't go, you’re a key part of what's next!

TextContext.SourceString: 先走的话，我的准备就失去意义了哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you leave, everything I've planned goes out the window.

TextContext.SourceString: 等一下！我给伊薇特准备了手写的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold on! I have a handwritten...

TextContext.SourceString: 欸，我真的可以知道吗？这是要去哪里……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, am I allowed to know? Where are we headed...?

TextContext.SourceString: ……贺卡？对哦，今天是我的生日……之前还想着，一定要提前邀请引航者，偏偏今天忘记了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...A card? Oh right, it's my birthday today... I was planning to invite the Navigator ahead of time, but I completely forgot...

TextContext.SourceString: 能被引航者记挂着，真是太好了。这张贺卡，我一定会好好珍惜……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's wonderful to know the Navigator remembered me. I'll definitely cherish this card...
